column4: cleat#3779: each of these four tests runs one subtest per dialect through eachDialectWithCountFixture, and each subtest calls testutil.TestDB, which skips when that dialect's DSN is unset. this PostgreSQL-only job configures the other dialect(s) so the the mysql and mssql arms skip while the configured one RUNS: 4 tests x 2 arms = 8. Measured by name with one DSN set at a time: env -i HOME=$HOME PATH=$PATH GOCACHE=<cache> GOPATH=<gopath> CLEAT_TEST_<DIALECT>=<dsn> go test ./engine/ -run '^Test(EventCountDoesNotGrowWhenAnAwaitIsReRecorded|EventCountDoesNotGrowWhenTheSameRecordsAreAppendedTwice|AnInflatedEventCountHealsAtTheNextAppend|EventCountOfACompactedRunIsStillTheNumberOfSteps)' -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' gives exactly these eight for postgres-only and for mysql-only; the mssql-only line is INFERRED by symmetry (no SQL Server instance was run for this change).
